title: Write features/daw/kit-preset.feature and STEPS.md; watch them fail
description:
## Intent

Write the kit export specs before any production code, and watch them fail.

## Scope

- `features/daw/kit-preset.feature` with every scenario of the M1 stories (apricitus-c162cd, apricitus-fed8f9, apricitus-c21928, apricitus-65d72f, apricitus-447b3a).
- `features/daw/STEPS.md`: the normative step vocabulary, in the style of `features/sources/STEPS.md` (State / Given / When / Then tables). Steps read the written preset (gunzip + XML) and compare against Apricity's own numbers (`apricity explain`, the compiled timeline), never against internals.
- Step definitions in `crates/apricity-daw/tests/daw_conformance.rs`. The "When I export" steps run the real `apricity` binary (assert_cmd or `CARGO_BIN_EXE_apricity`) so the CLI surface is covered too.
- Library scenarios build a temp library with `apricity_data::Library::create`.

## Out of scope

Making them pass.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw_conformance
```
Fails for the right reason (no `export` command / no rack writer), recorded in a comment with the output.

## Release

`test(<this task id>): specs for kit export`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the crate chore.
